title: Iatridis 1998 anterior outer AF confined compression zero-strain aggregate modulus H_A0 (degenerate (grades III-V))

quantity.name: zero-strain aggregate modulus H_A0
quantity.definition: zero-strain aggregate modulus of finite-deformation biphasic model

source.authors: Iatridis JC, Setton LA, Foster RJ, Rawlins BA, Weidenbaum M, Mow VC
source.sample: 44 AF cylinders (22 axial, 22 radial; 5 mm diameter, 1.6+-0.3 mm thick) from the anterior outer AF of 22 L2-L3 discs; normal (grades I-II) n=28, degenerate (grades III-V) n=16

protocol.summary: Confined compression of 5 mm AF cylinders (axial or radial orientation) between porous sintered-steel platens in a confining chamber; platen set at thickness minus 1 SD; 0.15 M NaCl added and free-swelling reference stress offset p0 measured at equilibrium (~4000 s); successive stress-relaxation steps: ramp at stretch rate 0.0001 /s to -10% then -5% increments, 2500 s holds, until -0.45 MPa; finite-deformation biphasic model (exponential strain-dependent permeability k = k0 exp(M(...)) and nonlinear elasticity with H_A0, beta) fitted per specimen. Values pooled over axial and radial orientation (no orientation effect).
how_to_simulate: Model a 5 mm diameter, 1.6 mm thick AF cylinder in confined compression (biphasic, porous platen), equilibrate in 0.15 M NaCl and report swelling stress
Apply ramp-hold steps (0.0001 /s, -10% then -5% increments, 2500 s holds)
Fit or compare equilibrium stress-stretch and relaxation response; report H_A0, beta, k0, M and p0

extraction.check_notes: Table 1 columns 1-2 (this study, pooled for orientation; text layer); Results text gives p0 0.126+-0.056 / 0.050+-0.046 MPa (Table 1 rounds to 0.13 / 0.05). Columns 3-5 of Table 1 are literature - not extracted. Biphasic parameters are per-specimen fits to measured relaxation. doi not printed.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
